scope: Read-only tools across Calendar / Gmail / GitHub providers

feature_test_scripts.scripts_summary: GET /calendars/{cid}/events with timeMin/Max/maxResults; singleEvents=true; orderBy=startTime; max_results bounds 1-250; default 20; refresh-on-401; PII safe (only id/title/start/end/location/attendees/html_link); _summarize handles all-day events (.date fallback when no .dateTime)

POST /freeBusy with calendar_ids; merges busy across calendars sorted by start; walks intervals subtracting busy; duration_minutes 5-1440; max_results 1-50; non-dict response → ToolError(provider_unexpected_response); cursor advances on overlapping busy; final tail-slot if window remains

POST /threads/{id}/modify with addLabelIds/removeLabelIds; model_validator enforces at least one non-empty list; thread_id min_length=1; summary unions labelIds across messages; sorted; system + custom labels both accepted

GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues with state/labels/assignee/per_page; filters PRs out (GitHub returns PRs in issues endpoint); state Literal['open','closed','all']; labels list AND-joined as ','; max_results 1-100
GET /repos/{repo}/pulls with state/base/head; ordered most-recently-updated; draft flag in summary; max_results 1-100
GET /pulls/{n} for JSON + GET /pulls/{n}.diff for unified diff (separate request); diff_excerpt truncated at _DIFF_EXCERPT_LEN=12000; number > 0; additions/deletions/changed_files surfaced
GET /commits/{sha}; sha 7-40 chars; per-file patch_excerpt capped at 4000 chars; total cap 16000 chars; files_changed/additions/deletions surfaced
